findings.summary: Feature does not belong in ripgrep: -F -f - plus a wrapper script already does it
No end-to-end test of the --base64 to -F wiring; repo requires rgtest! for new flags
Man page overclaims (regex, certificates, regardless of position) and omits short-query limit
Flags like -x, -w, -i, empty pattern quietly break --base64 searches
Machine-written copy: em dashes, ad-copy lists, over-wide line
Lean: two enums for one choice
Lean: tuple rebinding instead of in-place mutation of low

why: Finding 1 says a wrapper script is the right place, matching the maintainer's out-of-scope reason.
